newsitem.title: UK: UK's Dunn & Co Christmas sales up 7.0 pct -- KPMG.
newsitem.headline: UK's Dunn & Co Christmas sales up 7.0 pct -- KPMG.

text.p: British retailer Dunn & Co's turnover during the first 15 days of its Christmas sale rose some seven percent to 2.3 million stg versus the year-ago period, receivers from KPMG said on Friday.
The receivers said they were negotiating with a number of parties interested in the upmarket men's clothing store company, which was placed in receivership on December 19.
The closing date for the initial bids was January 6.
"We've had several good offers for the company," a KPMG spokesman said, adding that the company expected it would be able to announce a sale in the near future.
"We're talking weeks rather than months," he said.
